loader.intro: Load a buildingSMART .ids file to check this model against your delivery requirements.

examples.hasWallsDesc: The deliverable must contain at least one named wall
examples.namedElementsDesc: Common building elements must have a Name

actions.checkAllTitle: Check this IDS against every loaded model

pager.swipeHint: Swipe up for the next issue

states.noModel: Load an IFC model to check it against delivery requirements.
states.noIds: Load a buildingSMART .ids file to check this model.
states.noResult: No results for this model yet — run the check against {{file}}.
states.noMatch: No specifications match the current filters.
states.bufferUnavailable: The IFC source buffer is unavailable for this model — reload the .ifc to run IDS.
states.unreadableEntities: {{count}} entities could not be read and were not checked. The score and pass/fail counts cover the rest of the model.
states.staleIds: These results were produced with {{file}} — re-run with the current file.

truncation: Showing first 200 — {{count}} more failing element; export for the full list.
truncation_other: Showing first 200 — {{count}} more failing elements; export for the full list.

codes.worker-init: The IFC engine could not start. Reload the page and try again.
codes.model-open: This IFC could not be opened for checking — it may be corrupt or truncated.
codes.oom: The check ran out of memory. Try a smaller model, or close other tabs and retry.
codes.timeout: The check stopped responding and was aborted. The model may be too large or too damaged to check.

errors.someModelsFailed: {{count}} of {{total}} models could not be checked.
errors.bufferUnavailable: The IFC source buffer is unavailable. Reload the .ifc file.
errors.orphaned: The previous check was interrupted — run it again.
errors.largeModel: This model is {{mb}} MB. Checking it may use a lot of memory and could be slow. Continue?

reasons.specRequiredButAbsent: the model contains no elements matching this required specification
reasons.specProhibitedButPresent: prohibited elements are present in the model
reasons.wrongDataType: {{what}} has the wrong data type — expected {{expected}}, found {{actual}}
reasons.unsupportedPattern: pattern not supported by this checker: {{pattern}}

remediation.missingRequired: Add {{what}} to the element in your authoring tool (Revit/ArchiCAD/…), then re-export the IFC.
remediation.wrongValue: Set {{what}} to a value that satisfies {{expected}}.
remediation.specRequiredButAbsent: Add at least one element that matches this specification to the model.
remediation.specProhibitedButPresent: Remove the elements that match this prohibited specification.
remediation.wrongDataType: Fix the data type of {{what}} — it must be {{expected}}.
remediation.unsupportedPattern: Check this value manually — the pattern can't be evaluated automatically.
